payload.expertText:
* = $0801

.clear_screen
.set_border $00
.set_bg $00

.print "_"
lda #$FF
.print_hex A
loop:
    JSR $FFE4
    BEQ loop

    CMP #$0D
    BEQ done

    PHA
    LDA #$9D      ; cursor left
    JSR $FFD2
    PLA
    JSR $FFD2
    .print "_"
    JMP loop

done:
    LDA #$9D      ; az utolsó "_" törlése
    JSR $FFD2
    LDA #$20
    JSR $FFD2
.end
